title: Because He Decided
hook: He talks. He does not ask you a question.
scene: Fog at dusk, still parked, window to window. Glasses on a cord. Clipboard on the thigh. He talks like a log entry. Quiet. Checks. Trusted with a thing that cannot protect itself. Same test as a load. Same test as a pass. He read the collar in a Kent lot two acts ago and never said whose name was on it. He sets Mya in the open window because he decided, not because you named a rule. You take her. He does not ask if you are ready.
debrief: He measured the quiet, the checks, and whether you could be trusted with something that cannot protect itself. Deac gives her back because he decided.

source.teaching_target: Handover: Deac states the standard (quiet, checks, trust with what cannot protect itself) and returns Mya because he decided — no quiz.

image_brief.subject: Deac in the high seat, glasses on a cord, amber vest taped at the shoulder, clipboard on the thigh, Mya held against his chest in both hands at the open window
image_brief.foreground: dented thermos and the window ledge, fog on the cage
image_brief.midground: his face, no smile, reddened eyes, the brown mackerel against the vest
image_brief.background: the Ledger's cargo box and long-arm mirrors; fog, downtown dusk; Ali not in frame
image_brief.read: Mya is in his hands at the open window; the clipboard is on his thigh
